attrs.Sql Query:
SELECT 
		PM3.PP_END_YEAR, 
		PM3.PP_NUM, 
		PM3.PYF_EYE_ID_PDT3, 
		PM3.PYF_GEN_SEQ_ID,
		PM3.PYF_PAY_BLK_PDT3, 
		PM3.PYF_PAY_TAC_TYP, 
		PM3.PYF_DATE_EFF, 
		PM3.PYF_PAY_DET_CD, 
		PM3.PYF_OT_ENV_IDC, 
		PM3.PYF_HRS_SCD_AMT, 
		PM3.PYF_ACTUAL_AMT, 
		PM3.PYF_PAY_RAT, 
		PM3.PYF_CASH_PMT_AMT, 
		PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC, 
		PM3.PYF_ADJ_DATE_EFF, 
		PM3.PYF_ADJ_SYS_GEN_IDC, 
		PM3.PYF_RSN_IDC, 
		PM3.PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN, 
		PM3.PFY_ID_BREAK_CODE, 
		PM3.PFY_FILLER,
		PM3.PYF_DDU_PYE, 
		PM3.PYF_ITW_MS, 
		PM3.PYF_ITW_XMP, 
		PM3.PYF_ITW_ADD 
FROM
		CPM_PM3_STG_TBL PM3

WHERE
(
PM3.PYF_RSN_IDC IN (' ', 'I', 'G') OR 
PM3.PYF_RSN_IDC IS NULL
)
AND

(
PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC IN (' ', 'A', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'N') OR 
PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC IS NULL
)
AND

PM3.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR
AND
PM3.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM

AND
PM3.PYF_PAY_DET_CD = 'WL'

ORDER BY
	PM3.PP_END_YEAR,
	PM3.PP_NUM, 
      PM3.PYF_EYE_ID_PDT3,
      PM3.PYF_GEN_SEQ_ID
 --, PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC

fields.name: v_IDENTIFICATION
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
                        
                       ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN), 

					' ',
                            
                      NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN) AND NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_CODE) AND 
			   NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_FILLER),

                                    PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN || PFY_ID_BREAK_CODE || SUBSTR(PFY_ID_FILLER, 1, 4),

                      NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN) AND NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_CODE) AND 
			   ISNULL(PFY_ID_FILLER),

                                    PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN || PFY_ID_BREAK_CODE,

                      NOT ISNULL(PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN),

					   PFY_ID_BREAK_SSN,

                          ' ')

		PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC, 
		PM3.PYF_ADJ_DATE_EFF,

		PM3.PYF_ITW_XMP, 
		PM3.PYF_ITW_ADD 
FROM
		CPM_PM3_STG_TBL PM3

WHERE
		PM3.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR
AND
		PM3.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM
AND
		(PM3.PYF_RSN_IDC in (' ', 'I', 'G') or PM3.PYF_RSN_IDC IS NULL)
AND
		(PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC NOT IN ('T', 'Y', '1', '2', '3', '4') OR PM3.PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC IS NULL)

AND
		PM3.PYF_PAY_DET_CD IN ('UO', 'WD', 'WE', 'WF', 'WG', 'P3', 'PS', 'XA', 'XB', 'JF', 'JG', 'JH')

ORDER BY

SELECT 
    a.PROCESS_NAME, 
    a.ERROR_MESSAGE, 
    a.ERROR_DATE,
    a.PP_END_YEAR,
    a.PP_NUM

FROM
    ERROR_TBL a,

    (SELECT
            b1.PROCESS_NAME,
            MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE
    FROM
        ERROR_TBL b1
    WHERE
        b1.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR
    AND
        b1.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM
--    AND
--        b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    AND
        b1.PROCESS_NAME in ('m_CPM_Load_CPM_NEWPAY_STG_TYPE_1_2_TBL', 'm_CPM_Load_CPM_NEWPAY_STG_ALT_TBL')
    GROUP BY
        b1.PROCESS_NAME
    ) b

WHERE
    a.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR
AND
    a.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM
AND
    a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE
AND
    a.PROCESS_NAME = b.PROCESS_NAME
